### Fixes
- Media note filters now save. On Obsidian 1.15.1, Bases renamed an internal method the filter editor relied on, so every rule added under **Settings → Media Manager → Media notes** was dropped without an error. Rules now save when you leave the field, as in a base, and still work on earlier Obsidian versions.

### Documentation
- The README is now a full user guide: installing, a quick start, every way to point a note at its media, each gallery option, the zoom and its keys, the video player, PDFs, the properties card and maps, images in notes, media notes, settings, supported files, storage and privacy, and troubleshooting.

### Validation
- 54 automated tests pass, plus lint and the production build.
- Checked in Obsidian 1.15.1 desktop: a rule typed in the filter editor is saved to the plugin's settings, shown again after closing and reopening Settings, and applied to media note embeds. Mobile was not tested on a device.
